name: sr-vat-gst
description: Suriname value added tax (Belasting over de Toegevoegde Waarde, BTW) for 2026 under the Wet Belasting over de Toegevoegde Waarde 2022 (S.B. 2022 no. 121) as amended by S.B. 2022 nos. 143 and 148 and S.B. 2023 no. 126, with the Minister's 2023 and 2025 decrees. Covers who must register (the SRD 1,000,000 turnover threshold, voluntary registration, the two-year lock), the 10% general rate, the 5% rate (water, electricity, cooking gas, domestic goods transport), the 25% rate (large or costly cars, motorcycles over 125 cc, boats, small aircraft, weapons, fireworks), the 0% rate (exports, outsourcing for foreign customers, petroleum and gold contractors, public bodies), exemptions, place of supply, reverse charge on services from abroad, input VAT and blocked items, pro rata and revision, invoices, the monthly return and payment before the 16th, refunds, the 2026 late-filing and late-payment penalty table and 6% interest. Trigger on: Suriname VAT, BTW Suriname, btw-aangifte, BTW-plichtig, S
